claims.value: 1-4 per line in ascending channel order (H1A 1,2; H1B 3,4)
claims.evidence: Table S2 column names carry replicate numbers per line (H1A.1,H1A.2,H1B.3,H1B.4) but not channels; assignment to channels by ascending channel order is inferred

claims.value: H9 female, H1 male, burb1 male, fiaj1 male, kolf2 male, sojd3 female; CVCL_9773, CVCL_9771, CVCL_AG74, CVCL_AF79, CVCL_AE29, CVCL_AE87
claims.evidence: Document S1 Supplemental experimental procedures, Cell lines (sex and HPSI/WiCell identifiers); accessions from Cellosaurus search by HPSI/WTSIi names

claims.value: competent: H9, H1, kolf2; non-competent: sojd3, burb1, fiaj1
phospho = TiO2 eluate; nonmodified = TiO2 unbound/wash fractions
claims.evidence: PRIDE sample processing protocol; RAW sample names 'modified' vs 'NON modified'
PRIDE field and protocol; RAW header 'Orbitrap Eclipse Method Summary'

claims.location: comment[dissociation method] / collision energy / ms2 mass analyzer
claims.value: non-modified: CID 35 NCE, ion trap (MS2 identification), SPS-MS3 HCD NCE 55 for reporters; phospho: HCD 36 NCE, Orbitrap 50K, isolation 0.7
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol (CID 35%, MS3 HCD NCE 55) for non-modified; phospho RAW headers 01864 (Collision Energy (%) = 36, ActivationType HCD, Orbitrap Resolution 50K, method '120min_OTOT_200ms_500Bar_50K'). The PRIDE protocol describes only the SPS-MS3 method

claims.value: 10 ppm; 0.8 Da (non-modified) or 0.05 Da (phospho); Trypsin; TMTpro K and N-term fixed, Carbamidomethyl C fixed, Phospho STY and Deamidated N variable (phospho only)
claims.evidence: Sequest HT workflow parameters in the Workflows table of each pdResult (NM: PeptideTolerance 10 ppm, FragmentTolerance 0.8 Da, static TMTpro/Carbamidomethyl; phospho: FragmentTolerance 0.05 Da, DynamicModification Phospho S,T,Y and Deamidated N); PRIDE data processing protocol

claims.value: DTT PRIDE:0000608; IAA PRIDE:0000599; hpHRP PRIDE:0000564
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol: 10 mM DTT, 20 mM iodoacetamide, high-pH fractionation into 12 concatenated fractions

limitations: The channel-to-sample map comes from the deposited Proteome Discoverer StudyInformation tables (read by HTTP range from the pdResult SQLite files), not from the paper text; supplementary Tables S2/S3 (mmc2/mmc3) could not be retrieved, mmc5 only gives sample column names
biological replicate numbers within a line are inferred (ascending channel order within the set); only the line-level and channel-level identities are stated
KOLF2-SF samples (3 channels set 1): the meaning of 'SF' is not stated; cell line is annotated as kolf2 with no treatment value, and the paper states they were excluded from the study
Pool channels (132C, 'Mix') = common reference of all samples per the protocol; cell line value 'pooled' is not an ontology term
Channels 133N, 133C, 134N of set 2 are unused (no row); the same three channels in set 1 are KOLF2-SF
Same biological material appears as two sources (suffix nonmodified / phospho) because the TiO2 flow-through and eluate are different injections series of the same TMT set

The PRIDE protocol describes only the SPS-MS3 method; the phospho acquisition (HCD MS2, Orbitrap 50K) comes from RAW headers of 01864 only; phospho files 01865-01875, 01888-01899 assumed identical (method file name identical for all A1-A12 runs, not all headers parsed)
Phospho collision energy 36 NCE, ion trap/Orbitrap analyzers and 0.05 Da tolerance for non-modified/phospho differ per row group
Non-modified dissociation recorded as CID (MS2 identification); quantification MS3 HCD NCE 55 is not representable in the single dissociation column

disease, age, ancestry, individual, passage number, culture medium (Essential 8 not in NCIT), storage temperature, developmental stage, organism part not available; organism part omitted because the record gives no anatomical source for cultured cells

Cell line values are Cellosaurus names (or BTO labels for WA01/WA09); tools check reports them as unresolved in CLO/BTO/EFO (iPSC HPSI lines not in those ontologies); the bundled curated cell line DB maps 'H9' to a different (Sezary) line and was not used
parse_sdrf cache-only error 'study sample' (PRIDE:0001013) is a cache artifact; cell line warnings are cache-only
Acquisition date and scan ranges not annotated (conflicting header/protocol values: PRIDE 350-1400, phospho header 350-1600)
2 pdResult search files are not annotated as data rows; supplementary raw mmc zip was parsed by a salvage routine
